# weir watch

<!-- Generated by `weir reference`. Do not edit: change the help text in src/main.rs and regenerate. -->

Follow a sync that is running, from any terminal.

```text
Follow a sync that is running, from any terminal

Usage: weir watch [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --follow
          Keep watching after it ends, and follow the next ones too

      --json
          Machine-readable output

  -q, --quiet
          Print errors only

  -h, --help
          Print help
```
